tagline.en: A monocular metric-depth model — recover real-world depth in meters from a single image.
tagline.zh: 单目度量深度模型——从单张图片恢复以米为单位的真实深度。

en: Metric3D is a monocular depth model that estimates metric depth — depth in real-world units — from a single image, rather than only relative depth. In WorldFoundry it serves as an independent geometry prior that other pipelines can build on.

It handles monocular depth estimation, metric depth estimation, and acts as a geometry prior. WorldFoundry exposes it through the shared geometry-prior pipeline and operator contract, and the VIPE SLAM defaults reference it by name through the shared priors factory.
In WorldFoundry you can call it directly for depth on a single image, or let a higher-level pipeline pull it in as its depth prior.
zh: Metric3D 是一个单目深度模型，从单张图片估计度量深度——即以真实世界单位表示的深度，而不仅是相对深度。在 WorldFoundry 中，它作为一个独立的几何先验，可供其他 pipeline 复用。
它支持单目深度估计、度量深度估计，并可充当几何先验。WorldFoundry 通过统一的几何先验 pipeline 与算子契约暴露它，VIPE SLAM 的默认配置也通过共享先验工厂按名称引用它。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你可以直接调用它对单张图片估计深度，也可以让更高层的 pipeline 把它作为深度先验引入。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you need metric (real-scale) depth from a single image, or a reusable depth prior that downstream 3D and SLAM pipelines can consume.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要从单张图片得到度量（真实尺度）深度，或需要一个可供下游 3D 与 SLAM pipeline 复用的深度先验时，使用它。

notFor.en: It's a geometry prior, not a full scene reconstructor or generator — pair it with higher-level pipelines for those tasks.
notFor.zh: 它是几何先验，而非完整的场景重建或生成器——重建与生成任务请搭配更高层的 pipeline。

en: Metric depth (real-world units) from a single image
Reusable geometry prior across WorldFoundry pipelines
Referenced by the VIPE SLAM defaults
zh: 从单张图片得到度量深度（真实世界单位）
